name: transport_control
title: Transport Control
description: Start, stop, record, seek song playback position, or adjust tempo with verification.

action.description: Transport action to perform: play, stop, record, tempo, seek, or pos

tempo.description: Target project tempo in BPM (10.0 to 522.0). Requires allow_protected=true.

position.description: Song playback position (normalized 0.0 to 1.0, or tick index)

allow_protected.description: Allow adjusting protected parameters such as tempo

verify.description: Whether to perform read-back verification after mutation
